summary: The requirement document describes a web platform where people and small businesses find and book verified lawyers, and where lawyers manage their cases, hearing dates, time and invoices. The operations team verifies lawyers and sees reports. The platform must work in English, Hindi and Tamil and be supported for one year after launch.

evidence.quote: The first release covers the marketplace and the lawyers' practice tools on the web.
Lawyers shall join the platform, list their practice areas, courts, languages and fees, and upload their Bar Council certificate.
The operations team shall verify each lawyer's certificate before the profile goes live.

stories: As a lawyer, I can join the platform and list my practice areas, courts, languages and fees
As a lawyer, I can upload my Bar Council certificate
As an operations team member, I can verify a lawyer's certificate before the profile goes live

evidence.quote: lawyers and clients shall get an SMS a day before each hearing.

stories: As a lawyer or client, I get an SMS a day before each hearing
